title: Quote: (on what happened after the iMac launch) The people around h...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: (on what happened after the iMac launch) The people around here--some of them left. Actually, some of them I got rid of. But most of them said, 'Oh, my God, now I get it.' We've been doing this now for seven years, and everybody here gets it. And if they don't, they're gone.
